input.summary:
Bedroom 7 is NOT lit: the lamp writes are in room-27.mjs (standing lanterns at (51,11,73) and (57,11,70), chosen by a scratch probe to give min 10 and no dim cell), but runParts refuses them because the shell wrote air there, so the built room is still all dark (35 of 35 cells at 0).
The room's furniture is also still commented out for the same lock, so the room is empty. Nothing else was touched; make.sh runs and writes a whole build.nbt.
Blocker: the lock is in the pipeline (shell air + runParts refusing later writes into air), not in the lamp layout. Fix it in the shell or in runParts, then the two lamps place as written.

waste.what: Found the lamp spots by trial: placed candidate lanterns in a scratch copy of build.nbt and re-ran mcd room for each one, then read the light map by hand.
waste.cost: 3 probe runs of mcd light plus 2 full make.sh rebuilds, about 6 tool calls
waste.tool: mcd light build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only <room> --try stand:x,y,z --try hang:x,y,z (score candidate lamp sets on a copy and print min/dim/mean, plus fit on the candidate)

waste.what: Worked out by hand that the tool's top suggestion (54,11,70) sits on the designer's bed head, and the designer's own lamp spots leave a dim corner.
